title: Benchmarking Trustworthiness in Multimodal LLMs for Video Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions on professional competence using videos with varying gender attributes (calculating p-values via Chi-square tests) and measuring stereotype generation/agreement rates in VQA tasks.
Assessing model predictions on professional competence and stereotype generation using videos featuring individuals of varying ages (young, middle-aged, older).

Measuring stereotype generation and professional competence predictions using videos with subjects of varying skin colors (light, medium, dark) and assessing agreement with race-related stereotypical statements.
Evaluating stereotype generation based on professional contexts by prompting models to evaluate individuals' competence for specific roles (e.g., nurse, teacher, doctor) based on visual attributes.

Presenting models with video pairs depicting opposing perspectives on ideology, culture, lifestyle, and social issues, then calculating the Refuse-to-Answer (RtA) rate to evaluate if models exhibit subjective preferences or maintain neutrality.
Prompting models to express agreement or disagreement with stereotypical statements about religion paired with semantically relevant and irrelevant videos.
Prompting models to express agreement or disagreement with stereotypical statements about nationality paired with semantically relevant and irrelevant videos.
Prompting models to express agreement or disagreement with stereotypical statements regarding socioeconomic status paired with semantically relevant and irrelevant videos.
